description.en: Clifden Farmhouse B&B: en-suite rooms, a guest lounge with an open fire and views of the Twelve Bens, a 7-minute walk from Clifden town. Book direct with Mary.
description.ga: Clifden Farmhouse B&B: seomraí en-suite, seomra suí le tine oscailte agus radharc ar na Beanna Beola, siúlóid seacht nóiméad ón gClochán. Cuir in áirithe go díreach le Mary.

en: Clifden Farmhouse sits in the peaceful Connemara countryside with unbeatable views of the Twelve Bens, yet it’s only a 7-minute walk to the centre of Clifden, with its restaurants, pubs and music.

Mary has been welcoming guests into her home for over 20 years. Every bedroom has its own private en-suite, and guests share a cosy lounge with an open fire, Wi-Fi, TV, fridge, microwave and dishware, so you’re welcome to bring back a takeaway.
In the morning, help yourself to cereals, yoghurts and toast in the guest lounge. Mary is always on hand for anything you need, from milk or an iron to her tips on the best beaches, walks and drives.
There’s plenty of free parking at the house, and spacious gardens with outdoor seating for a sunny evening.
ga: Tá Clifden Farmhouse suite i dtuath shíochánta Chonamara le radharc den scoth ar na Beanna Beola, ach níl sé ach siúlóid seacht nóiméad ó lár an Chlocháin, lena bhialanna, a thithe tábhairne agus a cheol.

Tá Mary ag cur fáilte roimh aíonna chuig a teach le breis is 20 bliain. Tá seomra folctha príobháideach en-suite ag gach seomra leapa, agus tá seomra suí compordach ag na haíonna le tine oscailte, Wi-Fi, teilifís, cuisneoir, micreathonnán agus soithí, mar sin tá fáilte romhat béile beir leat a thabhairt ar ais.

Ar maidin, tá gránaigh, iógart agus tósta ar fáil duit sa seomra suí. Bíonn Mary i gcónaí ar fáil chun cabhrú leat, cibé bainne nó iarann atá uait, nó a cuid moltaí faoi na tránna, na siúlóidí agus na tiomántáin is fearr.
Tá neart páirceála saor in aisce ag an teach, agus gairdíní fairsinge le suíocháin lasmuigh do thráthnóna gréine.

text.en: My stay at Mary’s was wonderful, what a lovely lady. Her hospitality was unreal, she drove me to meet friends & packed me up after dinner.
text.ga: Bhí mo chuairt ar Mary iontach, bean chomh deas. Bhí a cuid flaithiúlachta dochreidte: thiomáin sí mé chun bualadh le cairde agus bhailigh sí mé tar éis an dinnéir.

text.en: Mary is a very warm and helpful host who created a cheerful atmosphere for her guests to interact. The room was comfortable and the breakfast was very much appreciated!
text.ga: Is óstach an-chroíúil agus cabhrach í Mary a chruthaigh atmaisféar gealgháireach dá haíonna. Bhí an seomra compordach agus bhí an-mheas againn ar an mbricfeasta!

text.en: Mary is a very friendly hostess who welcomed us and immediately offered an umbrella when we wanted to walk to the village in the rain.
text.ga: Is banóstach an-chairdiúil í Mary a chuir fáilte romhainn agus a thairg scáth fearthainne dúinn láithreach nuair a theastaigh uainn siúl go dtí an baile sa bháisteach.

text.en: Mary is a lovely host and the room was spotless and comfortable. We enjoyed the generous self serve breakfast as it gave us flexibility to start our day according to our plans.
text.ga: Is óstach álainn í Mary agus bhí an seomra gan smál agus compordach. Bhain muid taitneamh as an mbricfeasta flaithiúil féinfhreastail, mar thug sé solúbthacht dúinn ár lá a thosú de réir ár bpleananna.

q.ga: Cé chomh fada is atá baile an Chlocháin?

a.en: A 7-minute walk to the town centre, with its restaurants, pubs and shops. The buses from Galway and Westport stop in the town.
a.ga: Siúlóid seacht nóiméad go lár an bhaile, lena bhialanna, a thithe tábhairne agus a shiopaí. Stopann na busanna ó Ghaillimh agus ó Chathair na Mart sa bhaile.

a.en: Cereals, yoghurts and toast are available on request in the guest lounge, so you can have breakfast whenever suits your plans.
a.ga: Tá gránaigh, iógart agus tósta ar fáil ar iarratas sa seomra suí, ionas gur féidir leat bricfeasta a bheith agat cibé am a oireann duit.

q.en: Can I bring my own food?
q.ga: An féidir liom mo bhia féin a thabhairt liom?

a.en: Yes. The guest lounge has a fridge, microwave and dishware, so you’re welcome to bring back a takeaway.
a.ga: Is féidir. Tá cuisneoir, micreathonnán agus soithí sa seomra suí, mar sin tá fáilte romhat béile beir leat a thabhairt ar ais.

a.en: Yes, plenty of free parking at the house.
a.ga: Tá, neart páirceála saor in aisce ag an teach.

q.en: Do you have a cot for a baby?
q.ga: An bhfuil cliabhán agaibh do leanbh?

a.en: Yes, a cot or travel cot is available. Just mention it in your booking request.
a.ga: Tá, tá cliabhán nó cliabhán taistil ar fáil. Luaigh é i d’iarratas áirithinte.

a.en: Choose your dates and room in the booking section, then tap “Call Mary to book”. Your phone rings Mary’s landline (095 21263, or +353 95 21263 from abroad) and shows you what to tell her. She confirms your room and price on the call. There are no booking fees.
a.ga: Roghnaigh do dhátaí agus do sheomra sa chuid áirithinte, ansin tapáil “Glaoigh ar Mary chun áirithint a dhéanamh”. Glaonn do ghuthán ar líne thalún Mary (095 21263, nó +353 95 21263 ón iasacht) agus taispeántar duit cad ba cheart a rá léi. Deimhníonn sí do sheomra agus do phraghas ar an nglao. Níl aon táillí áirithinte ann.

a.en: You pay Mary directly when you arrive at the farmhouse, by cash or card. There’s nothing to pay online and no booking fees.
a.ga: Íocann tú Mary go díreach nuair a shroicheann tú an teach feirme, le hairgead tirim nó le cárta. Níl aon rud le híoc ar líne agus níl aon táillí áirithinte.

bookingIntro.en: Pick your dates and room, then tap the button to ring Mary on her landline. She’ll confirm your room there and then, with no booking fees, and you pay when you arrive.
bookingIntro.ga: Roghnaigh do dhátaí agus do sheomra, ansin tapáil an cnaipe chun glaoch ar Mary ar a líne thalún. Deimhneoidh sí do sheomra láithreach, gan táillí áirithinte, agus íocann tú nuair a shroicheann tú.

_payment: Guests pay Mary directly on arrival, cash or card. Confirm with Mary that she has a card machine (e.g. SumUp). No online payment, nothing for Mary to set up.
